brief:
A modeling reference sheet (turnaround) for ONE low-poly 3D game asset: a round cartoon frying pan with a golden pancake in it, the central prop of a cooking game.

Canvas and layout, keep exactly:
- 1536 x 1024 landscape image, a 2 x 2 grid of four equal panels.
- Top-left panel: FRONT view. Top-right: RIGHT side view. Bottom-left: BACK view. Bottom-right: TOP view (looking straight down).
- In EVERY panel the whole object, its long handle included, fits inside its own panel with an empty margin of at least one tenth of the panel on every side: nothing crosses into another panel. Draw the object small enough for that (the TOP view is the tallest: pan plus handle about 70 percent of the panel height).
- Orthographic cameras (no perspective), the same scale in every panel, the object centred in each panel and standing on the same invisible ground line in the three side views.
- Each side view is exactly frontal to its side: no other face of the object shows in it (a slightly oblique view comes out wider and fails the aspect gate).
- The four panels show the SAME object, only turned: FRONT: the handle points straight at the camera. RIGHT: the camera has walked round to the pan's own right-hand side, so the handle points to the LEFT edge of the image. BACK: seen from behind, the handle hidden behind the pan. TOP: seen from straight above, looking down, with the handle pointing towards the BOTTOM edge of the image. Each detail appears only in the views from which it is really visible.
- One flat, uniform, mid grey background (#9a9a9a) everywhere: no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient, no vignette, no frame lines, no text, no labels.

The object (identical in all four views), 1.45 m long in all with its handle:
- The pan: a round, 12-sided pan 0.9 m across at the rim and 0.7 m across at the flat bottom, 0.16 m tall, with sloped side walls and a thick rolled rim.
- The handle: a long thick straight handle 0.55 m long, 0.12 m wide, 0.1 m tall, sticking straight out from the pan's side towards the FRONT, rising slightly, with a rounded end cap.
- In the pan: one thick round pancake 0.66 m across and 0.08 m thick, its top just below the rim, its top face golden with a darker golden edge.

Style, keep exactly:
- A clean low-poly 3D model render: faceted, flat-shaded faces, hard straight edges, big readable chunky shapes, about 300 triangles worth of detail. No smooth organic surfaces, no tiny details, no texture noise, no grain, no bubbles.
- Flat colour areas only, ONLY these colours (a pastel palette, Vanilla Milkshake): pan #6c5671 (lit) and #28282e (shade) with a #b0a9e4 rim top; handle #f98284 with a #feaae4 end cap; pancake top #ffc384, pancake edge #dea38b.
- Soft, even light from the upper left, so each face reads as one flat tone; no specular highlights, no ambient occlusion blur.
